mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_lock(lock_id, user_id, product_id, product_name, total_amount, lock_status, lock_time, expire_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{lockId}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{totalAmount}, #{lockStatus}, #{lockTime}, #{expireTime}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT lock_id, user_id, product_id, product_name, total_amount, lock_status, lock_time, expire_time FROM order_lock WHERE lock_id = #{lockId}

SELECT lock_id, user_id, product_id, product_name, total_amount, lock_status, lock_time, expire_time FROM order_lock WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId} AND lock_status = 'LOCKED' ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
